name: Propylsilanetriyl triacetate
description: Propylsilanetriyl triacetate (CAS 17865-07-5 ) is an organosilane monomer used as a crosslinking agent and surface modifier in silicone-based systems. On hydrolysis, it releases acetic acid and generates a reactive propylsilanetriol intermediate. This intermediate bonds to inorganic substrates and polymer networks, functioning as a building block for moisture-cure formulations. It is utilized across several industrial sectors for silane-modified materials. In adhesives, sealants, and elastomers, it acts as a crosslinker in acetoxy-cure silicone systems. This contributes to network formation and adhesion to glass, metal, and mineral surfaces for industrial use. Coatings formulators use it to improve substrate wetting and durability on concrete, stone, and treated metals. These applications are common in architectural and protective coating projects requiring high performance. In electronics, it supports encapsulant and potting compound formulations where controlled cure rates are critical. It ensures reliable surface bonding to circuit substrates during the manufacturing process. The building and construction sector applies it in silicone sealants designed for glazing and façade work. It provides long-term adhesion under environmental stress for joint sealing in modern infrastructure. Propylsilanetriyl triacetate is supplied as a liquid and is available in technical grade. Packaging options typically range from small drums to bulk quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. Buyers should confirm purity specifications and moisture-sensitive handling requirements with the supplier prior to ordering.
